lines: Your first question to ChatGPT never gets an ad.
The ads wait for the follow-up.
Ask about price, or where to buy.
About one answer in six comes with a sponsored card.
We've logged four thousand seven hundred ChatGPT ads from almost seventeen hundred advertisers, all in the US.
Even OpenAI runs ads there, for its own Ads Manager.
See which ads show up next to your brand with SupaIntent.
profile: American female, about 40, marketing lead explaining one sharp finding to a peer. Dry, deadpan wit with a smile in the voice, confident, lively, ~185 WPM, close-mic.
music: Instrumental only, no vocals. Sly playful tech groove: muted funk guitar, round bass, crisp claps, glassy synth stabs, a small reveal in the middle, 112 BPM, 30 seconds.
